messages:
Elaine (Docs): Quick heads-up — I'm assembling a tiny 'evidence chain' section for the SOC2 audit-log docs. Want to include a schematic + runnable SDK export snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 :eyes:
Sam (Security): thanks. Can you paste the proposed JSON schema and the retention wording here? I can scan for compliance gotchas.
Elaine (Docs): pasted below. thinking to use example 365-day default TTL, with explicit tenant-level overrides and a legal-hold flag. also want a short code sample to export evidence for auditors.
Elaine (Docs): JSON schema example:
```json
{
  "evidence_id": "uuid-v4",
  "collected_at": "2026-02-12T15:23:01Z",
  "source_type": "audit_log",
  "tenant_id": "acct_1234",
  "event_count": 2345,
  "redacted_fields": ["user_email", "ip_address"],
  "ttl_seconds": 31536000,
  "legal_hold": false
}
```
Matt (SDK): small nit: ttl_seconds=31536000 is 1 year, you said 365 days earlier. fine but maybe prefer human-friendly field like "retention_days": 365 in docs examples so non-dev readers don't misread.
Elaine (Docs): good point. will show both in the example and explain mapping.
Nijah (Legal): language check: instead of "we keep logs for X by default" use "By default, Redwood retains audit evidence for 365 days; customers may configure retention per-tenant where permitted by contract." keeps it precise and audit-friendly.
Kai (PM): FYI, customers have asked for a migration note when they change retention (how exported evidence is affected). Can we add a short migration paragraph?
Elaine (Docs): proposed migration blurb: "Changing a tenant's retention window does not retroactively delete previously archived evidence; new TTLs apply to subsequent writes. For legal holds, existing evidence remains preserved until the hold is released." ok?
Sam (Security): sounds right. add a developer-facing caution about export integrity when redaction rules change: if you run export after changing redaction config, exported artifacts may differ from originals. auditors will want provenance.
Elaine (Docs): will add provenance fields: exported_by, export_timestamp, schema_version, and a provenance_hash. snippet below for SDK export (Python + cURL).
Elaine (Docs): cURL quick export:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acct_1234&since=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" \
  -o evidence_export_20260212.jsonl
```
Elaine (Docs): Python SDK example:
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
with client.export_evidence(tenant_id="acct_1234", since="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") as stream:
    for line in stream:
        # each line is a JSON record matching the evidence schema
        process(json.loads(line))
```
Matt (SDK): one more SDK note — export streaming currently yields JSONL with schema_version v2. Add that to the example output and note in docs that older SDKs will get v1 and may need a migration helper.
Elaine (Docs): added. also found one broken link in retention guide: docs/retention-policy.md#default-ttl anchor is wrong (was #default-ttl-days). deploy-bot, can someone open a tiny linkfix PR?
deploy-bot: Reminder: open PR checklist — add link fix, update changelog entry.
Sam (Security): Nijah, can you sign off on legal_hold phrasing and the migration blurb?
Nijah (Legal): quick read: legal_hold -> "evidence marked under legal hold will be retained until release and is exempt from standard TTL-based deletion." that phrasing is fine. approve from legal.
Kai (PM): timeline — we'd like this in docs next deploy. Elaine, do you want me to coordinate with SDK team for adding the migration helper snippet?
Elaine (Docs): yes please, if Matt can add a 3-line helper in SDK repo that converts v1->v2 fields, we can link it. Matt?
Matt (SDK): will follow up in SDK channel, can PR a helper by EOD.
Elaine (Docs): great. I'll update the PR with the new phrasing, add the linkfix, and include the SDK helper link when ready. thanks everyone. :tada:
